privacy_lede: The framework and policy of Hamedan University of Technology on collecting, using and protecting users' information.
privacy_description: The framework and policy of Hamedan University of Technology on collecting, using and protecting users' information.
privacy_s1_p1: In the interest of transparency and respect for its visitors' rights, Hamedan University of Technology sets out in this statement the framework and policies that govern how information from users of its official website is collected, used and protected.
privacy_s1_p2: The university is committed to keeping its visitors' information confidential and private. If, while you use the services of this site, identifying information is requested to provide better service, simplify procedures or gauge user satisfaction, it will be used only in line with the principles and commitments set out in this document. The university also relies on security standards, modern technical infrastructure and protective protocols to guard against criminal acts, unauthorized access and unforeseen events beyond the organization's control.
privacy_s2_p1: Under Article 7 of Resolution No. 1127128 of the Supreme Administrative Council, dated 28 Esfand 1395 (19 March 2017), Hamedan University of Technology considers itself bound to fully respect the privacy of all visitors and users, and limits the collection of information strictly to what is needed to provide the requested services. Publishing this data or handing it over to unrelated parties is therefore strictly prohibited.
privacy_s3_title: Data minimization: collecting the least information
privacy_s3_p1: The university's official website collects only the basic, necessary information needed to provide users with electronic, educational, research and administrative services, and avoids requesting anything unnecessary.
privacy_s4_p1: Hamedan University of Technology reaffirms its organizational commitment to protecting users' information. Users' personal data will not be made available to any third party, natural or legal, except where a competent judicial or legal authority officially requires it. In addition, standard security measures and layers of protection are in place to prevent unauthorized access, destruction, disclosure, alteration and misuse of data.
privacy_s5_p1: Hamedan University of Technology reserves the right to review, amend or update this statement as the organization changes, its systems are upgraded or new laws are enacted. Visitors are asked to read this page from time to time to learn of changes to the university's protection policies.
privacy_s6_p1: This website may contain links to other electronic portals. Once you leave the Hamedan University of Technology website, the university has no technical or legal control over the destination sites. It therefore accepts no responsibility for their privacy policies or content, and recommends that you read the privacy statement of those sites before using them.
privacy_s7_p1: If you have any question, concern, comment or report about this statement, you can reach the responsible officials through the contact channels in the “Contact us” section of the Hamedan University of Technology portal.
